requirements.title: Ready only with a commit
requirements.statement: A workspace SHALL be ready only when it has a commit.

requirements.title: Readiness explains itself
requirements.statement: Readiness SHALL say why a workspace is not ready.

scenarios.title: Why
scenarios.then: it says there is no commit

requirements.title: Readiness answers plainly
requirements.statement: A readiness check SHALL answer yes or no, as its recipe promises.

scenarios.title: Asked
scenarios.then: the answer is yes or no

tickets.title: Make readiness faster
tickets.body: Active, with a proposal: the draft the views show.

tickets.title: Readiness ignores submodules
tickets.body: A gap, off the first screen.

tickets.title: Name the readiness module
tickets.body: Closed by the fixture, touching a requirement and relying on a page that have since gone.

tickets.title: Should readiness count submodules?
tickets.body: A question the per-workspace report waits on.

tickets.title: Report readiness per workspace
tickets.body: Needs refinement: it waits on whether submodules count.

tickets.title: Cache readiness
tickets.body: Ready: it relies on nothing open.

tickets.title: Should readiness follow symlinks?
tickets.body: Answered, and nothing built on it.
tickets.close: No: a symlink is read as the file it names.

tickets.title: Readiness misses detached heads
tickets.body: Answered, with a change built on it.
tickets.close: A detached head counts as a commit; filed as a change.

requirements.statement: Readiness SHALL name each error it finds.

scenarios.title: Named
scenarios.then: the error names the missing commit
